metadata.title: World Digest — November 8, 2026
metadata.summary: Mississippi's Senate race hangs in the balance as Democrat Scott Colom could become the state's first Black senator, while markets tumbled in their worst rout in 19 months amid a deepening AI selloff.

sections.title: Major Events
sections.content:
Mississippi Nears Historic Senate Pick

Mississippi’s Senate race remains too close to call, with Democrat Scott Colom potentially becoming the state’s first Black senator as vote counting drags on The Washington Post.

Eisenkot Tapped to Form Israeli Government

Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot received the mandate to build a coalition, signaling a likely end to Benjamin Netanyahu’s tenure as prime minister Al Jazeera.

GOP Blames Losses on Vance

Republicans distance themselves from VP JD Vance after midterm defeats, with potential 2028 challengers emerging and some refusing to endorse him The Washington Post.

Trump AG Threatens Legal Action

Attorney General Todd Blanche refuses to rule out prosecuting Democrats who pledge to investigate the administration, deepening partisan conflict Axios.

Philadelphia Boycott Sparks Counter-Rally

Hundreds of counterprotesters overwhelmed a bike ride boycotting Jewish-owned businesses, highlighting rising tensions over Israel-related activism 6abc Philadelphia.

NYC Schools Employee Arrested in Jogger Killing

Police charged a city schools worker with murder in the fatal stabbing of a Brooklyn jogger, shocking local communities Gothamist.

Texas Elects Gina Hinojosa Governor

Democrat Gina Hinojosa won the Texas governorship, vowing bipartisanship while planning to fire the education commissioner and end school takeovers The New York Times.

Egypt Train Crash Kills Seven

A collision between two trains near Cairo killed at least seven and injured over 125, prompting safety concerns AP News.

New Zealand Election Heads to Coalition Talks

No clear winner emerged from New Zealand’s tight election, leaving leaders to negotiate for weeks over forming a government NPR.

NASA Telescope Crash Near Miss

The destroyed Swift observatory captured a final image of an approaching galaxy before re-entering Earth’s atmosphere Live Science.

sections.title: Political News
sections.content:
Global Politics

A former RFK Jr. adviser requested records on White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles’s health policy influence, alleging corruption and obstruction of “MAHA” initiatives The Hill. Deputy Chief of Staff Richard Walters departed ahead of Stephen Miller’s expected takeover The Hill. Iran issued a two-day ultimatum to the US to accept a proposal or face “hell” The Hill. Separately, Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot, tasked with forming a government, signaled openness to including Netanyahu in a coalition Al Jazeera.

sections.title: Financial News
sections.content:
Markets Tumble as AI Rout Deepens; Crypto Heist Rocks Binance

Stocks suffered their worst rout in 19 months as the AI trade was hammered, though Nasdaq saw some buying Yahoo Finance. The selloff boosted Treasuries, pushing the 10-year yield to a two-month low Bloomberg. In crypto, Binance named a new CFO after a record $6.3 billion hack Fox Business. Tesla announced it will discontinue the Cybertruck TechCrunch. Berkshire Hathaway formalized Greg Abel's succession The Motley Fool. Nvidia faced scrutiny over cleared sales to Chinese firms with empty offices The New York Times. Anthropic secured a $3.4bn gas-power deal Financial Times.

sections.title: Entertainment News
sections.content:
Entertainment

Japanese cinema made history as Godzilla Minus Zero stomped to a record $63M worldwide, topping box offices and beating Ramayana Variety. Denis Villeneuve teased progress on the next James Bond at the LACMA Gala, praising the creative process Los Angeles Times. Maya Jama stepped down as Love Island host after nine seasons BBC. Russell Brand awaits sentencing after rape and sexual assault convictions NPR.

sections.title: Sports
sections.content:
Basketball

  • Golden State Warriors 126, Orlando Magic 119 (OT) — Stephen Curry scored 41 points as the Warriors won their seventh straight ESPN.
  • Oklahoma City Thunder 114, Washington Wizards 75 — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander led a rout, and the Thunder acquired Nique Clifford from the Kings ESPN ESPN.

Football

  • Kansas City Chiefs 35, New York Jets 12 — Kenneth Walker scored three TDs to end Kansas City's two-game skid ESPN.
  • Cincinnati Bengals 34, Atlanta Falcons 17 — Joe Burrow powered the Bengals to their fourth straight win in Madrid ESPN.
  • Denver Broncos 26, Carolina Panthers 21 — Bo Nix threw two TDs for Denver's fifth straight victory ESPN.

Hockey

  • Boston Bruins 4, Florida Panthers 1 — Elias Lindholm scored in a three-goal first period ESPN.

Soccer

  • Manchester United sit in the Premier League relegation zone, but Michael Carrick insists he deserves to keep his job ESPN.

sections.title: Stock Analysis
sections.content:
IPOs

Interpace Biosciences (IDXG) and Leader's Advantage Acquisition (LEDR) priced on Nasdaq Nov. 6 Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Haymaker Acquisition Corp V (HYAC) lists on NYSE Nov. 9 Yahoo Finance. Deep Sea Minerals (SEAM) follows Nov. 10 on Nasdaq Yahoo Finance.

Major Indices

The Nasdaq led, up 1.09% to 24,579.43, while the Dow fell 0.46% to 51,285.73 Yahoo Finance. The S&P 500 rose 0.31% to 7,376.86 Yahoo Finance. The VIX tumbled 9.01% to 25.64 Yahoo Finance.

Sectors

Technology led, +1.45% Yahoo Finance. Consumer Staples lagged, down 1.28% Yahoo Finance. Financials and Materials fell 0.59% and 0.73%, respectively Yahoo Finance.

Major Stocks

Tesla surged 4.23% Yahoo Finance. Nvidia gained 2.78% Yahoo Finance. Microsoft dropped 0.99%, and Apple fell 0.52% Yahoo Finance.

Notable Movers

Top gainers: Karman Holdings +42.1% Yahoo Finance, Firefly Aerospace +36.8% Yahoo Finance. Top losers: iRhythm -30.7% Yahoo Finance, DraftKings -21.3% Yahoo Finance. Most active: Intel +7.7% Yahoo Finance.

Rates & Commodities

The 10-year yield edged up 0.45% to 4.86% Yahoo Finance. Gold rose 0.76% to $4,106 Yahoo Finance. Oil slipped 0.26% to $90.59 Yahoo Finance. Bitcoin was flat at $75,747.58 Yahoo Finance.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
• 24-48 hours: Mississippi Senate outcome may determine if Colom makes history. Eisenkot’s coalition talks could reshape Israel’s leadership. Markets likely to remain volatile as AI rout tests resilience, with Binance fallout unfolding.

  • Next week: New Zealand coalition negotiations intensify; Haymaker Acquisition V lists. Texas transition begins, with Hinojosa signaling education shakeups. Iranian ultimatum deadline could escalate tensions.

  • Next month: Watch Godzilla Minus Zero’s continued box office run and Anthropic’s AI infrastructure deals. Vance’s political future likely crystallizes amid GOP distancing.

theme.name: Tension in Amber
theme.note: A day of waiting — a historic Senate race hanging by a thread, markets in freefall, and governments yet to form — cast in the restless glow of a stalled moment.
